title: o-mcp/aggregate version 1
description: One quantity across several nodes over a window. A counter (energy, volume) or a derived quantity is one total per node, worked out on the network model as the values format does, metered or not. A sampled quantity (voltage, current, power, THD) is the minimum, mean, 95th percentile and maximum of each meter's readings: a row per meter, since two meters' readings aren't merged. Returned by GET /api/aggregate. Times are site time with their offset; windows are half-open (end excluded). Unknown fields may appear in later version-1 documents; ignore them.

schema.description: Names the format. Check it, and version, before reading anything else.

version.description: Format version. Adding fields keeps it at 1; removing, renaming or changing the meaning of a field makes 2.

nodes.description: Node ids (graph.node.id), in the order asked, duplicates removed.

unit.description: Unit of every figure in rows.

reading.description: COUNTER: a running register; SAMPLE: an instantaneous value; DERIVED: computed from two counters (PF_TRUE).

statistic.description: TOTAL: each row's total holds the figure, and min, mean, p95 and max are null. SPREAD: the other way round.

resolution.description: The data the figures come from. minute: minute readings (a window of 6 hours or less within the minute data kept). 15min: 15-minute values; for a SPREAD each is the last reading in its 15 minutes, so a shorter dip or spike between two of them doesn't show. day: the daily summary, for a TOTAL over whole site days.

window.description: The window the figures cover. For a TOTAL, the requested window snapped outwards to its resolution; for a SPREAD, the requested window.

source.description: The table read: telemetry_data, telemetry_15min_agg or daily_energy_cost_summary, or for a TOTAL that read several, the one whose data stops first.

data_until.description: Where the data read stops, site time with offset; null when there was none. Short of window.end, findings has DATA_INCOMPLETE.

pieces.description: TOTAL only (empty for a SPREAD): the parts the window was worked out in, each on the network of its own last day. One piece unless the plant changed inside the window (finding PLANT_CHANGED).

as_of.description: The network the piece was worked out on.

rows.description: TOTAL: one per node, in the order asked. SPREAD: one per meter on each node (on the node or its feeder edge, on the window's last day), nodes in the order asked and meters by code; a node with no meter has one row with origin NO_METER. A node not in the plant on the window's last day has no row (finding NOT_IN_PLANT).

code.description: Node code on the window's last day.

device_id.description: SPREAD: the meter's device id; null for NO_METER and for a TOTAL.

total.description: TOTAL: the node's total over the window; null when it has none (finding NO_VALUE or NOT_IN_NETWORK), which is not zero.

origin.description: How the figure was found; new values may appear. MEASURED: from a meter (always so for a SPREAD row with a meter). The others are the solver's, for a TOTAL: ROLLUP and CHILDREN from what the node feeds, IN_EDGES from its feeders, OUT_EDGES from its out-edges, INHERITED its feeder's, DERIVED computed from two quantities, NONE no value. NO_METER: a SPREAD row for a node with no meter.

min.description: SPREAD: the smallest reading; null when the meter had none.

mean.description: SPREAD: the mean of the readings.

p95.description: SPREAD: the 95th percentile of the readings (continuous).

samples.description: SPREAD: readings the statistics rest on. null for a TOTAL.

expected.description: SPREAD: readings a meter reporting every minute (resolution minute) or every 15 minutes gives in the window. samples well short of it means gaps.

last_reading.description: SPREAD: start of the meter's last reading in the window, site time with offset.

findings.description: What the server noticed. Show message as is.

code.description: NO_VALUE, NOT_IN_NETWORK, PLANT_CHANGED, DATA_INCOMPLETE, NO_METER, NO_READINGS, NOT_IN_PLANT; new codes may appear.

node_id.description: The node it is about, when one.

device.description: The meter it is about, when one.
